sql:
SELECT
  pc.ProductCategoryName AS ProductCategoryName,
  sumIf(f.SalesAmount, toYear(f.DateKey) = 2007) AS Sales2007,
  sumIf(f.SalesAmount, toYear(f.DateKey) = 2008) AS Sales2008,
  sumIf(f.SalesAmount, toYear(f.DateKey) = 2009) AS Sales2009,
  (sumIf(f.SalesAmount, toYear(f.DateKey) = 2007) - sumIf(f.TotalCost, toYear(f.DateKey) = 2007)) * 100.0 / nullif(sumIf(f.SalesAmount, toYear(f.DateKey) = 2007), 0) AS GrossMarginPct2007,
  (sumIf(f.SalesAmount, toYear(f.DateKey) = 2008) - sumIf(f.TotalCost, toYear(f.DateKey) = 2008)) * 100.0 / nullif(sumIf(f.SalesAmount, toYear(f.DateKey) = 2008), 0) AS GrossMarginPct2008,
  (sumIf(f.SalesAmount, toYear(f.DateKey) = 2009) - sumIf(f.TotalCost, toYear(f.DateKey) = 2009)) * 100.0 / nullif(sumIf(f.SalesAmount, toYear(f.DateKey) = 2009), 0) AS GrossMarginPct2009,
  GrossMarginPct2008 - GrossMarginPct2007 AS YoYChange_2008_vs_2007_pp,
  GrossMarginPct2009 - GrossMarginPct2008 AS YoYChange_2009_vs_2008_pp
FROM retail.FactOnlineSales AS f
INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p ON f.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
INNER JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory AS ps ON p.ProductSubcategoryKey = ps.ProductSubcategoryKey
INNER JOIN retail.DimProductCategory AS pc ON ps.ProductCategoryKey = pc.ProductCategoryKey
WHERE toYear(f.DateKey) IN (2007, 2008, 2009)
GROUP BY pc.ProductCategoryName
ORDER BY pc.ProductCategoryName
